properties.name: synapse.api.grpc.errors.status.*
properties.description: gRPC status for an error code, for every operation. Write the error code in brackets, for example synapse.api.grpc.errors.status.[BOOK_NOT_FOUND]=FAILED_PRECONDITION.

properties.name: synapse.api.grpc.operations.*.errors.status.*
properties.description: gRPC status for an error code, for one operation; it wins over synapse.api.grpc.errors.status. Replace the first * with the operation name and write the error code in brackets, for example synapse.api.grpc.operations.get-book.errors.status.[BOOK_NOT_FOUND]=OUT_OF_RANGE.
